other_conditions: The applicant’s parent must be engaged in building and other construction work
The applicant’s parent must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The applicant’s parent must have an active membership with the Board
The student must be a permanent resident of Assam
The student must be enrolled in educational programmes from Class I up to postgraduate or higher studies
benefits_summary: Provides annual scholarships ranging from ₹1,500 to ₹20,000 based on the student's education level, and covers all expenses for higher studies in government institutions.
